metadata.name: deep_rewards
metadata.description: DEEP Holder Rewards: per-(token, reward asset) cumulative Merkle distributor

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Admin transfer, step 2 (signed by the proposed admin).

instructions.name: activate_root
docs: PERMISSIONLESS after the pending root's eta. Re-checks the funding bound.

instructions.name: apply_config_update
docs: PERMISSIONLESS once the queued change's eta has passed (and within the 14-day grace).

accounts.name: pending_config
docs: Must be in the current layout: a PendingRewardsConfig written before the guardian
existed is refused until the permissionless `migrate_config` has re-written it, so its
old bytes are never read as a guardian.

instructions.name: cancel_config_update
docs: Admin: drops the queued settings change.

accounts.name: pending_config
docs: Must be in the current layout: a PendingRewardsConfig written before the guardian
existed is refused until the permissionless `migrate_config` has re-written it, so its
old bytes are never read as a guardian.

instructions.name: claim_sol
docs: The claimant (signer) takes `cumulative_amount − claimed` lamports from a SOL
distributor. Never paused. `ClaimStatus` is created on first claim (claimant pays).

instructions.name: claim_token
docs: The claimant (signer) takes `cumulative_amount − claimed` of the reward token into a
token account it owns. Never paused.

accounts.name: claimant_token
docs: Any token account of the reward mint owned by the claimant.

instructions.name: deposit_sol
docs: Anyone: adds `amount` SOL to a SOL distributor's holder vault (Phase 2–3 may CPI this
or credit the vault directly; see docs/V1_FEES.md section 4.5).

instructions.name: deposit_token
docs: Anyone: adds `amount` of the reward token to a token distributor's vault.

instructions.name: init_distributor
docs: Creates the distributor for (`mint`, `reward_mint`). Admin or root authority (the
keeper inits Holder-Rewards tokens). For SOL the payer funds the holder vault's 0-byte
rent minimum (kept as `vault_reserve`, so every lamport already deposited stays
distributable) and the vault's WSOL ATA; for a token it funds the vault's ATA.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Admin or root authority; pays rent.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The token whose holders are rewarded (SPL Token or Token-2022).

accounts.name: reward_mint
docs: The paired asset (WSOL mint for native SOL).

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: idempotently in the handler.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the RewardsConfig. Only the program's upgrade authority may call it (blocks
deploy-time front-running); the signer becomes `admin`.

instructions.name: migrate_config
docs: PERMISSIONLESS, idempotent: brings a RewardsConfig and PendingRewardsConfig written
before the guardian existed (devnet) to the current rules. Moves no funds.
* `PendingRewardsConfig` grows from 280 to 312 bytes (the payer funds the rent
difference). Its params are re-written in the new layout with NO guardian (the zero
key), so a change that was queued before the upgrade can no longer be applied: the
admin cancels it and queues it again with a guardian. Until this instruction has
run, `queue_config_update`, `apply_config_update` and `cancel_config_update` fail
with `ConfigNotMigrated`.
* `RewardsConfig` keeps its size (the guardian takes 32 of its reserved bytes, so it
reads as "no guardian" until the admin's next settings change sets one), and its
`root_delay_seconds` is raised to the new minimum if it is below it. Nothing is ever
lowered.
A second call changes nothing.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; funds the rent difference of the grown PendingRewardsConfig.

accounts.name: pending_config
docs: size are checked in the handler.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin transfer, step 1. `Pubkey::default()` cancels.

instructions.name: propose_root
docs: Root authority: publishes the next cumulative root. It always waits as pending
(replacing any older pending root) for `root_delay_seconds`, until `activate_root`; the
admin or the guardian may veto it meanwhile. No root is ever active at once: the delay
is at least `MIN_ROOT_DELAY_SECONDS` (params validation and `migrate_config`), and this
instruction has no path that activates.

instructions.name: push_sol
docs: AUTO-SEND (PERMISSIONLESS crank, payout mode 1 only): pushes a holder's unclaimed SOL
when it is worth at least `push_min_usd_micros` at the Pyth SOL/USD price. The recipient
must be a plain system account (a wallet) that ends rent-exempt; otherwise the
instruction fails, nothing changes, and the amount stays claimable.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone; pays the ClaimStatus rent on a first push and the fee.

instructions.name: push_token
docs: AUTO-SEND for a token distributor whose reward mint is a configured USD stablecoin
(valued at face). Other assets are claim-only. Creates the claimant's ATA idempotently
(cranker pays); a frozen recipient account fails the instruction (stays claimable).

instructions.name: queue_config_update
docs: Admin, step 1 of EVERY settings change (root authority, guardian, payout mode, root
delay, thresholds, caps, price account, stablecoins, stray recipient). Validates now and
waits `config.root_delay_seconds` (the delay in force at queue time, at least 12 h) before
anyone can apply it, so a key rotation or a payout change is public before it bites.
One change at a time; cancel to replace it. Never touches funds.

accounts.name: pending_config
docs: Must be in the current layout: a PendingRewardsConfig written before the guardian
existed is refused until the permissionless `migrate_config` has re-written it, so its
old bytes are never read as a guardian.

instructions.name: recover_stray
docs: PERMISSIONLESS: moves a token balance that is NOT a reward asset out of a holder vault
token account (e.g. the rewarded token itself sent to the vault, or an airdrop) to
`config.stray_recipient` (its ATA, created idempotently, caller pays), then closes the
emptied account with its rent to the stray recipient. Reward assets (native SOL / WSOL,
configured stablecoins, any mint with a distributor for this token) are refused, so this
can never take holder rewards.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone; pays the stray recipient's ATA rent if it does not exist.

accounts.name: vault_token
docs: Any token account of `stray_mint` owned by the holder vault.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Admin or guardian: pauses (or resumes) root publication and pushes. Claims are NEVER
paused. Moves no funds.

instructions.name: unwrap_wsol
docs: PERMISSIONLESS: turns the WSOL in ATA(WSOL, holder_vault) (DeepSwap reward fees) into
lamports of the holder vault, through a temporary WSOL account created and closed here.
The caller fronts the temporary account's rent and gets it back in the same
instruction; the vault's ATA is never closed (deep-amm pays into it).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fronts the temporary account's rent; refunded in the same instruction.

instructions.name: veto_root
docs: Admin or guardian: discards the pending root. Moves no funds; the active root stays.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin or the guardian.

errors.name: NoRoot
errors.msg: no root has been activated yet

errors.name: RootNotMonotonic
errors.msg: new root total is below the active one

errors.name: RootUnfunded
errors.msg: root promises more than the vault holds

errors.name: StaleSnapshot
errors.msg: snapshot slot not newer than the active one, or in the future

errors.name: PushDisabled
errors.msg: auto-send is disabled (payout mode is CLAIM)

errors.name: BelowPushThreshold
errors.msg: unclaimed amount below the auto-send threshold

errors.name: PushUnsupportedAsset
errors.msg: auto-send is not supported for this reward asset (claim only)

errors.name: PriceInvalid
errors.msg: Pyth SOL/USD price missing, stale or invalid

errors.name: ConfigUpdatePending
errors.msg: a settings change is already queued

errors.name: ConfigUpdateNotReady
errors.msg: the queued settings change is not yet applicable

errors.name: ConfigUpdateExpired
errors.msg: the queued settings change expired; cancel and re-queue

errors.name: NotStray
errors.msg: this token is a reward asset, not stray

errors.name: ConfigNotMigrated
errors.msg: PendingRewardsConfig is in the old layout; run migrate_config first

types.name: ClaimStatus
docs: Per (distributor, claimant): the cumulative amount already paid. Permanent: closing it
would let the same cumulative leaf be claimed again.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent (the claimant, or the AUTO-SEND cranker).

fields.name: mint
docs: The token whose holders are rewarded.

fields.name: reward_mint
docs: The paired asset paid out; `NATIVE_MINT` means native SOL.

fields.name: reward_token_program
docs: Token program of `reward_mint` (SPL Token for SOL's WSOL ATA).

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: `["holder_vault", mint]`: holds SOL rewards and owns the token vaults.

fields.name: token_vault
docs: ATA(reward_mint, holder_vault): the token vault (SOL: the WSOL ATA to unwrap).

fields.name: vault_reserve
docs: SOL only: the vault's rent-exempt minimum, funded by `init_distributor`'s payer.

fields.name: round
docs: Number of roots activated so far (0 = none yet).

fields.name: max_total_claim
docs: Sum of all cumulative leaves of the active root.

fields.name: data_hash
docs: sha256 of the published tree file for the active root.

types.name: GuardianChangeQueued
docs: The guardian a queued settings change would set (emitted with `ConfigUpdateQueued`).

types.name: GuardianSet
docs: The guardian in force (emitted with `RewardsConfigUpdated` by `initialize` and
`apply_config_update`).

types.name: PendingRewardsConfig
docs: The queued settings change (`queue_config_update` → `apply_config_update` after eta).

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks `propose_root` and pushes. Claims are never paused.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Veto-only key: `veto_root` and `set_paused` (security review F1). Takes the first 32 of
the 64 bytes that were reserved, so the account size is unchanged and a config written
before it existed reads as the zero key, i.e. no guardian.

fields.name: root_authority
docs: Hot key of the snapshot job; publishes roots. Must differ from the admin.

fields.name: stray_recipient
docs: Receives NON-reward tokens swept out of holder vaults by `recover_stray` (default: the
admin; DEEP V1 Phase 1 sets it to the deep-curve fee vault).

fields.name: guardian
docs: Veto-only key (appended; security review F1): may sign `veto_root` and `set_paused`,
nothing else. Meant to be a key that can act faster than the admin (mainnet: the
instant "pause" Squads vault, while the admin sits behind a 48 h time lock). Never the
root authority, never the zero key.
